newsitem.title: USA: White House downplays Clinton meeting with GOP.
newsitem.headline: White House downplays Clinton meeting with GOP.

text.p: The White House on Monday sought to play down expectations of President Bill Clinton's meeting with congressional leaders on Tuesday, saying the session was not the beginning of budget negotiations and that a range of subjects would be discussed.
"This is not the commencement of a budget negotiation," White House spokesman Mike McCurry told reporters.

"I would caution you against thinking this will be a session that focuses exclusively on the budget," he added. "I imagine they will discuss that subject, but that will be one of only many subjects to be raised ... given our understanding."

Republican Senate Majority Leader Trent Lott and House of Representatives Speak Newt Gingrich have invited Clinton to a meeting at the Capitol at 1100 EST (1600 GMT) on Tuesday. Senate Democratic Leader Tom Daschle and House Democratic Leader Richard Gephardt are also expected to attend.
